title.en: Implementing the Final 25% Increase in Distilled Spirits, Wines, Compounded Liquors and Fermented Liquors Pursuant to BP Blg. 82

text.en:
The final 25% increase in specific tax rates on distilled spirits, wines and compounded liquors, and
fermented liquors under Sections 145(a); 146(b) to (h); and 147 respectively, of the National Internal Revenue
Code as amended by BP 82 shall take effect on April 12, 1982.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
